caption: The drawing features a single object, a detailed and ornate spur. The main body of the spur is brown and decorated with intricate swirling patterns. Attached to the side is a round, circular element with a metallic appearance, decorated with a floral or star-like geometric design in shades of gray and white. The arm of the spur extends outward, consisting of a metallic band with rivets and decorative engravings, primarily in silver and gray hues. The end of the arm features a dark, spiked rowel, resembling a star with multiple points, each tip capped with a circular metallic piece. Several short metal chains dangle from the bottom of the central part of the spur. The drawing is set against a beige background with irregular, splattered stains radiating outward from the object, suggesting an aged or parchment-like surface. There is a small, printed name, "VERNA TALLMAN," in the lower right corner.
title: Spur
